# dsh-team-dev
A self-contained Dev Team bundle for DeepSeek Harness. One plugin row brings two capabilities:
1. **Step budget guard** — a per-agent, per-turn tool-call budget. Soft threshold (default 20) warns
non-teammate sessions; the hard threshold (default 25) denies every tracked non-allowlisted call **
before it runs**, directing the agent to write a handoff, update its task, and report to the Lead. A
llowlisted tools (`write`, `edit`, `team_task_update`, `send_message`) keep working so the agent can
wind down. Default `onlyTeamMembers: true` budgets Agent Teams teammates only — the Lead is never c

apped.
2. **Bundled skills** — installing the plugin installs the `team-dev` (dev team orchestration
) and `team-boot` (general task team) skills from the package's `skills/` directory. Project (rank 1
00) and user (rank 400) skills still override these bundled ones (rank 600).
Zero runtime dependencies.

ion` for each release (`node scripts/verify.mjs` first).
